title: Issuing Referrals and Authorizations After a Reconsideration Overturns the Denial
content:
When a Medical Necessity Reconsideration or Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration of a denied authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** is decided overturned or decided partially overturned, the authorization is issued.

A home health care authorization overturned on reconsideration is not issued until every skilled nursing facility authorization of the patient whose validity span has ended shows as expired or exhausted.

Put the other way round, while any Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization of the patient whose validity span has ended still shows a status other than expired or exhausted, an overturned Home Health Care Authorization of that patient is not issued.

## What issuing records

- The authorization's status changes from denied to approved, with today as its decision date.
- Its validity span and units authorized are set, its denial reason is cleared, and its units remaining are set to the units authorized.
- One grant entry on the basis of an appeal overturn is added to its unit history.
- The servicing provider, the request details and the referral number are not changed.

## Invocation

The tool is `issue_overturned_authorization_2ad92a55`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the denied authorization being issued, as returned by the referral and authorization lookup for the patient | identifier, as returned |
| `valid_from` | the first day of the validity span | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `valid_through` | the last day of the validity span, inclusive | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `units_authorized` | the units issued, in the authorization's own unit of measure (visits, inpatient days, hours or rental months) | whole number, 0 or more |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `grant_entry_id` (the reference number of the new grant entry), `referral_authorization_id` (the authorization issued), `status` (reading "approved" once recorded), `valid_from` and `valid_through` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `units_authorized` (the units issued).
